dishes.name: Frankfurt green sauce
dishes.desc: Cold sauce of seven fresh herbs with sour cream and yoghurt, served with boiled eggs and potatoes. The city's signature dish, protected as a regional specialty.

dishes.name: Handkäse mit Musik
dishes.desc: Sour-milk cheese marinated in vinegar, oil and onions. Eaten with bread in apple-wine taverns, where 'Musik' refers to the onion dressing.

dishes.name: Frankfurter Würstchen
dishes.desc: Thin, smoked pork sausages heated in water and served with mustard and bread. The original Frankfurter, long made in the city.

dishes.name: Frankfurter Rippchen
dishes.desc: Cured and boiled pork chop served with sauerkraut, mustard and bread. A staple of Sachsenhausen taverns.

dishes.name: Bethmännchen
dishes.desc: Small marzipan balls with three almond halves on the side, baked until just golden. A Frankfurt Christmas sweet that is now sold in bakeries all year.
